audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart disagreed with the mirror (tryndamere__yone.json) and with the packet chart at rows 2, 5 and 6.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is [Tryndamere, Tryndamere, Tryndamere, Skill, Skill, Skill, Skill]; the mirror explicitly set row 2 to Tryndamere and rows 5-6 to Skill.
audit.corrected: Row 2 -> Tryndamere (rating 4/10), rows 5 and 6 -> Skill (5/10), proposed in matched full+content pairs.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text named the abilities but carried no cooldown numbers, so the level 3-5 window read as vague.
audit.why: Spinning Slash is 12/11/10/9/8s and Bloodlust is 12s — the punish window is the spin cooldown, not a feeling.
audit.corrected: spikes[0].text now states the 12s Spinning Slash window and ties Executioner's Calling to Bloodlust.

audit.whatIsWrong: Undying Rage was described only as 'Unkillable 5s' with no cooldown, and the cooldown breakdown listed no real numbers.
audit.why: Undying Rage is 120/100/80s and Yone's Soul Unbound is 22/19/16/13/10s — both decide who may commit first.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d and breakdown.cooldowns rewritten with the real timers; phases[2].why now keys the level-3 window to his 12s spin.

audit.why: Mocking Shout carries a 'projectile' derived flag, but Riot's own description is a point-blank cry with no missile. Flag misfire — nothing written about blocking it.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Tryndamere must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Spinning Slash (E) lands at 3 and is down 12s after — that gap is your only trade window. Keep the wave near your side and punish it.

edits.before: Unkillable 5s. Q3-R after it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Undying Rage stops death 5s and is 120s at rank 1. Bait it, then commit.

edits.before: - Tryndamere Undying Rage: matchup-defining — Unkillable 5s. Q3-R after it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Undying Rage: 120s at rank 1, denies death 5s — track it before every engage. - Spinning Slash: 12s at rank 1; after he spins, punish. - Soul Unbound (E): 22s at rank 1 — never spend it on chip.

edits.before: Tryndamere's Spinning Slash (E) gives him gap-close and his Bloodlust (Q) heals off crits, so his early auto-trades and Mocking Shout (W) AD-shred out-damage your Q pokes badly.
edits.after: Spinning Slash (E) is 12s at rank 1 — once he spins in, that window is yours. Bloodlust (Q) heals off his fury every 12s, so Executioner's Calling before you contest extended auto-trades.

notes: Mocking Shout's 'projectile' derived flag contradicts Riot's description (a point-blank cry) — treated as a parsing misfire and not written to the page. Chart rows 0, 1 and 3 left alone: the mirror did not edit them, so flipping them unilaterally would create a new disagreement.
